lines: Clear water wells up through white stone. It tastes of nothing at all, which up here is a luxury.

sign: Under the Great Orrery the stars come loose. Someone is catching them and selling them.
star_clerk: Benedikt: Isaura reads the stars. I read Isaura. She's lying about at least two of them.
star_clerk_intro: Benedikt: Your horoscope says: a battle. Today. Now.
star_clerk_defeat: Benedikt: Your horoscope also said you'd lose. Refunds are not available.

lines: I read your stars this morning. They said you lose. I charged them for the reading.
Isaura: The stars sit still again. I'll have to make up the future myself now. Like always.
Isaura: The Gilt House paid me for your horoscope. You might want a new one. I'm offering a discount.

isaura_intro: I read your stars this morning. They said you lose. I charged them for the reading.
isaura_defeat: The stars were wrong. Do not tell my customers. I have refunds to avoid.
